decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated a range of speakers from premium brands like JBL to budget-friendly options like INSMY and Raymate. While the JBL Charge 5 is highly regarded with a 4.8 rating, the price is significant. Several of the mid-range and budget speakers (Altec Lansing, Comiso) had concerning reviews regarding their waterproof claims and reliability, with some customers reporting units being dead on arrival or leaking. I am specifically looking for a durable, waterproof outdoor speaker, and the conflicting reports on build quality among the affordable options, combined with the high price of the top-tier model, lead me to defer my purchase until I can find a better balance of value and verified durability.
